text: I am busy in the morning.
Hello, Ender. We need a call about the new cards project. Are you available on Tuesday?
Hi, Priya. Let me check my calendar. On Tuesday I am busy in the morning. What about Wednesday?
Wednesday is good for me. What time?
At nine in the morning, São Paulo time. Is that okay?
Let me see. With the time zone, nine in São Paulo is five thirty in the afternoon in Mumbai. Perfect.
Great. The invite is in your email in five minutes.
Thank you. And the second call? Is it on Friday?
No, my Fridays are full. Let’s schedule it for next week, on Monday at ten.
Monday at ten. Okay. See you on Wednesday!
Is nine a.m. okay for you?
Let's schedule it for next week.

Hi Ender, it's Sarah, from Mastercard. Quick message about the global call. It is not on Thursday at nine anymore. The new day is Friday, at ten in the morning, São Paulo time. That is eight in the morning in New York. The invite is in your email. And the next global call is in December, on the first Friday. Thanks, and have a good day!

In the winter, London is three hours ahead of São Paulo. So my calls with Brazil are always in the afternoon. They are usually at two, London time. That is eleven in the morning in São Paulo: good for everybody. I never have calls on Fridays in the afternoon. On Fridays, I work from home, and I finish early.
